name: Cadence Design Systems

logo.source: commons.wikimedia.org - Wikipedia infobox logo file: Cadence-Logo.svg

description: Cadence sells the software, hardware and pre-built design blocks that chip and electronics makers use to design semiconductors and systems. The largest part is core electronic design automation (EDA) software for custom, digital and verification work, plus emulation hardware; it also licenses semiconductor IP (ready-made interface and memory designs) and system design and analysis software for simulating products and systems. Customers are chip makers, big tech firms and electronics makers; most revenue is recurring licences and maintenance, with IP and hardware recognised up front. It operates as one segment and its 10-K names Synopsys and Siemens EDA among its competitors.

gics.note: Conventional label as listed in the Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' table (GICS sector and GICS sub-industry columns). That table does not give the industry group or industry levels, so they are null rather than filled from memory.

hq.note: Owned HQ campus; about 1.33M sq ft of owned buildings (FY2025 10-K)

employees.note: FY2025 10-K; a substantial majority are engineers

businessLines.name: Core EDA
businessLines.how: Term software licences and maintenance on recurring contracts, plus up-front sale or lease of emulation hardware; customers renew as they design successive chips.
businessLines.description: Custom IC design and simulation, digital IC design and signoff, functional verification (including emulation and prototyping hardware).

businessLines.name: Semiconductor IP
businessLines.how: Licence fees per IP block, largely recognised up front when delivered, plus engineering services for customised IP.
businessLines.description: Pre-designed interface, memory and foundation IP blocks, including Arm Artisan foundation IP bought in FY2025 and Secure-IC security IP.

businessLines.name: System Design and Analysis
businessLines.how: Software licences and subscriptions sold to electronics and industrial engineering teams, increasingly as time-based contracts.
businessLines.description: Simulation and analysis software for electronics and mechanical/multiphysics systems (including BETA CAE and Hexagon Design & Engineering/MSC Software, bought February 2026).
